changeSet.author: nexus-6pbwx
changeSet.comment: nexus.catalog_collection_doc_owner(tenant, collection): the owner segment (first two dot-segments of the tumbler, hyphenated) of the live documents in a collection, the owner with the most documents winning; NULL when no live document has an owner-address tumbler. SECURITY INVOKER, so the caller's tenant policy applies.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.catalog_collection_doc_owner(p_tenant text, p_collection text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER AS $fn$ SELECT o.seg FROM ( SELECT split_part(d.tumbler, '.', 1) || '-' || split_part(d.tumbler, '.', 2) AS seg, count(*) AS n FROM nexus.catalog_documents d WHERE d.tenant_id = p_tenant AND d.physical_collection = p_collection AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.tumbler ~ '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' GROUP BY 1 ) o ORDER BY o.n DESC, o.seg LIMIT 1 $fn$;
changeSet.rollback: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.catalog_collection_doc_owner(text, text)

changeSet.author: nexus-6pbwx
changeSet.comment: Triggers that apply the nexus-6pbwx owner rule wherever it can arrive: BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF owner_id, content_type on catalog_collections, and AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF physical_collection, deleted_at on catalog_documents. Both SECURITY INVOKER. No existing row changes here; catalog-044-3 repairs those.

changeSet.author: nexus-6pbwx
changeSet.comment: nexus-6pbwx: one-off repair of existing code/docs/rdr collection rows whose owner_id is not tumbler-shaped (a slug, "default", a tenant-id placeholder) and that have live documents: owner_id becomes the owner segment of those documents, by the same nexus.catalog_collection_doc_owner the triggers use. Rows without documents, knowledge rows and quarantine rows are untouched. DATA EFFECT: UPDATEs catalog_collections.owner_id for every code/docs/rdr row whose owner_id does not match ^[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)*$ and that has at least one live catalog_documents row with a three-segment numeric tumbler; reversible in effect only, no rollback SQL (the prior value was a name-derived slug and is recoverable from the collection name).
changeSet.sql: SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'; LOCK TABLE nexus.catalog_collections, nexus.catalog_documents IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;
